facts.text: I want a WordPress function that allows me to use a shortcode to display a list of custom posts.
I want the shortcode to let me specify how many posts to display.
I want the shortcode to let me specify a category.
I want the shortcode to let me specify a taxonomy.
I want the code updated to display a custom post type named "policy" instead of showing posts.
I want the shortcode updated to use a taxonomy's category instead of the WordPress post category.
For the Policy custom post type, I have a taxonomy called "Topic".
I need the shortcode to list the Policies within a given Topic such as "academic-affairs" or "student-life".
I want a WordPress shortcode that could display the first 5 policies of each topic.
I want the topic to be displayed as an unspecified element.
I want the custom post type policies to be a hyperlinked list.
I want a WordPress PHP single template for a custom post type called "Policy".
The Policy single template should display associated Advanced Custom Fields for Title.
The Policy single template should display associated Advanced Custom Fields for Published Date.
The Policy single template should display associated Advanced Custom Fields for Unit (a custom taxonomy).
The Policy single template should display associated Advanced Custom Fields for Topic (a custom taxonomy).
The Policy single template should display Body content.
The Policy single template should display Additional Resources in a collapsible row.
The Policy single template should display History in a collapsible row.

events.text: Create a WordPress PHP single template for a custom post type called "Policy"
